name: Valley
description: The rural and vibrant home region of Bloomburrow's animalfolk, with meadows, ponds, marshes, hills and thickets.

description_citations.text: "Bloomburrow (plane)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the distant Season of Chaos the animalfolk survive underground and band together to form the Order of the Holly Leaf.
timeline.quote: the animalfolk survived buried underground until they banded together forming the Order of the Holly Leaf

citation.text: "Bloomburrow (plane)", section "Season of Chaos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The animalfolk develop weaving and win their first victories against the weaker Calamity Beasts.
timeline.quote: had their first victories against the weaker Calamity Beasts

citation.text: "Bloomburrow (plane)", section "War of Cinders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Wildsear turns the tide against the animalfolk during the War of Cinders.
timeline.quote: until Wildsear, the wildfire wolf, turned the tide against the animalfolk

citation.text: "Bloomburrow (plane)", section "War of Cinders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lily of Valley wields the Seed Flame, drives off Wildsear and forges Cragflame from its broken tooth in the final battle.
timeline.quote: she drove the weakened Wildsear away from Valley and fashioned the sword Cragflame from its broken tooth

citation.text: "Bloomburrow (plane)", section "War of Cinders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Magic drives some weavers mad into rage-fueled monsters, so the great weavings are sealed.
timeline.quote: This led to the great weavings being sealed, in favor of small spells anyone could manage.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow (plane)", section "Weavers' calamity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With great weaving gone, the Calamity Beasts return and the animalfolk learn to cope using specialized small weaving, forming Valley's civilization.
timeline.quote: This specialization led to the formation of the actual civilization of Valley.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow (plane)", section "Foundation of Valley". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: King Glarb hires Cruelclaw to steal a Calamity Beast's egg, reawakening the Beasts' fury.
timeline.quote: King Glarb hired the weaselfolk mercenary Cruelclaw to steal a Calamity Beast's egg, reawakening their fury

citation.text: "Bloomburrow (plane)", section "Calamity returns to Valley". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maha attacks villages including Pondside and Fountainport, and the Flood Gar floods Three Tree City.
timeline.quote: Maha attacked multiple villages, including Pondside and Fountainport, and the Flood Gar flooded Three Tree City.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow (plane)", section "Calamity returns to Valley". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mabel's group of small warriors and misfits returns the egg, stopping the Beasts.
timeline.quote: A group of small warriors and misfits under the leadership of Mabel returned the egg, stopping the Beasts.

citation.text: "Bloomburrow (plane)", section "Calamity returns to Valley". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Finneas, a rabbitfolk, assists Mabel in her quest to stop the Calamity Beasts.
timeline.quote: One of their kin, Finneas , assisted Mabel in her quest to stop the Calamity Beasts .

citation.text: "Rabbit", section "Bloomburrow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mabel returns Maha's egg and saves Valley from the stolen egg's consequences.
timeline.quote: When the mercenary Cruelclaw stole the egg of the mighty Calamity Beast Maha, it was Mabel who saved Valley.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Mabel's village is destroyed and her family separated, and she vows vengeance on Glarb.
timeline.quote: When her village was destroyed and her family separated, Mabel knew Glarb was to blame.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
